name: ArenaTableCellLayout
description: How an ArenaTable column's cells render in card mode: `row` is a label/value pair, `block` is a full-width strip with no label whose contents sit at the end of it, which is the shape an actions cell wants. A long value takes `row` or a cell of its own: set to `block` it draws with the whole gap on its leading side. Checked against every enum already declared here; nothing carries this pair. ArenaSkeletonVariant is the only other declaration containing the value `block`, and it names a shape of placeholder rather than a layout.
